title: Match the general cubic-log lower bound against adaptive protocols
statement: Centered temporal filters reveal Hamiltonian-activated coherence while one uniform mathematical squashing map bounds all assisted inputs.

evidence.quote: ## 5. Why the cubic law holds in every finite dimension

requires: Fix finite dimension d and a time-independent Lindblad generator L(rho)=-i[H,rho]+sum_a(L_a rho L_a^dagger-{L_a^dagger L_a,rho}/2), using a canonical TRACELESS Lindblad family and its associated Hamiltonian. N_t=exp(tL); B_t=N_t^c is the FULL PURE-ENVIRONMENT coherent complementary channel. Alice prepares inputs and may retain a reference; Bob receives the complete coherent environmental output; residual source is discarded. Each use has a fresh environment. LOCC and two-way classical communication are available, with NO initial shared entanglement. Q_two-way is qubits per fresh use. Generator/dimension stay fixed as t decreases; a fixed time unit makes log(1/t) dimensionless. Exact rational-complex/algebraic descriptions support the stated branch tests; physical coefficient/interface acquisition is separate.
Commuting normal noise with pointer levels i,j and selected L such that Delta=ell_j-ell_i!=0 and H_ji!=0.
provides: Let G=-iH-sum_a L_a^dagger L_a/2 and one-jump density K(u)=exp(G(t-u))*L*exp(Gu). Select constant fc=t^-1/2 and centered-linear fl=sqrt(12)*t^-3/2*(u-t/2). The centered component exposes[L,G]=-i[L,H]. Known midpoint input preparation and an explicit filter give p_t=|Delta|^2*t/2+O(t^2),conditional rho_10,10=O(t^4),rho_00,11=c*t+O(t^2),|c|=|H_ji|/sqrt12.

Conditional coherent information is |H_ji|^2*t^2*log2(1/t)/6+O(t^2), giving the source lower bound Q_two-way>=|Delta|^2|H_ji|^2*t^3*log2(1/t)/12+O(t^3). The generic operational construction further earns its concentration/coding implementation; it does not stop at a formal entropy witness.

For pointer P_i and sigma_i(t)=N_t^dagger(P_i), source derives 1-Tr sigma_i(t)^2=(t^3/3)*sum_a ||[L_a,[H,P_i]]||_2^2+O(t^4). The first possible mixed spectral tail is cubic. Measuring the DISCARDED system in the pointer basis defines one mathematical squashing map uniformly over every reference/input, including t-dependent inputs.

That single map bounds associated average conditional entropy by O_L(t^3 log(1/t)); established channel squashed-entanglement machinery then bounds arbitrary adaptive two-way protocols, with no maximum/infimum interchange. The discarded-system measurement is an upper-bound device, not an additional receiver resource.
